_readme: Hand-checked corrections for players Wikidata can't disambiguate — it lists
several countries with no ranks and no start/end dates, so the resolver
refuses to guess and writes them to player-countries-review.json instead.
Add an entry here (iso2, plus a note saying how you checked) and re-run
Entries here always win over Wikidata.

Alexander Bublik.note: Wikidata carries bare Russia + Kazakhstan claims, undated. Has represented Kazakhstan since 2016; ATP lists him as KAZ.

Alex De Minaur.note: Dual AU/ES on Wikidata with no tie-break. Represents Australia; ATP lists him as AUS.
